body:
### Summary

Installing a differently named package for the same module (e.g. `xgboost-cpu` installed over `xgboost`) seems unrelated in the conflict resolution. 

Doing a manual remove of the old package, deletes a bunch of files in the site-package module as well.

### Expected behaviour:
- recognize different packages for same module -> having both `xgboost` requirement should have been a conflict in the first place, I believe
- do not remove module files that belong to another installation -> can only be recovered with a --reinstall[-package]

### Steps to reproduce:

```
$ uv init
Initialized project `uv-uninstall-issue`

$ uv add xgboost="==3.0.5"
Using CPython 3.13.7
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
Resolved 5 packages in 11ms
      Built uv-uninstall-issue @ file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue                                                                                                                                                                              Prepared 1 package in 10ms
Installed 5 packages in 15ms
 + numpy==2.5.3
 + nvidia-nccl-cu12==2.32.3
 + scipy==1.18.1
 + uv-uninstall-issue==0.1.0 (from file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue)
 + xgboost==3.0.5

$ uv run python -c "import xgboost; print(xgboost.__version__)"
3.0.5

$ ls .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost*
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost:
callback.py  collective.py  compat.py  config.py  core.py  dask  data.py  _data_utils.py  federated.py  __init__.py  lib  libpath.py  plotting.py  __pycache__  py.typed  sklearn.py  spark  testing  tracker.py  training.py  _typing.py  VERSION

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost-3.0.5.dist-info:
INSTALLER  METADATA  RECORD  REQUESTED  WHEEL

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost.libs:
libgomp-e985bcbb.so.1.0.0

$ uv add xgboost-cpu
Resolved 6 packages in 13ms
      Built uv-uninstall-issue @ file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue                                                                                                                                                                              Prepared 1 package in 7ms
Uninstalled 1 package in 0.29ms
Installed 2 packages in 2ms
 ~ uv-uninstall-issue==0.1.0 (from file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue)
 + xgboost-cpu==3.4.1

$ uv run python -c "import xgboost; print(xgboost.__version__)"
3.4.1

$ ls .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost*
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost:
callback.py  collective.py  config.py  dask     _data_utils.py  __init__.py   lib         objective.py  __pycache__  sklearn.py  testing     training.py  VERSION
_c_api.py    compat.py      core.py    data.py  federated.py    interpret.py  libpath.py  plotting.py   py.typed     spark       tracker.py  _typing.py

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost-3.0.5.dist-info:
INSTALLER  METADATA  RECORD  REQUESTED  WHEEL

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost_cpu-3.4.1.dist-info:
INSTALLER  licenses  METADATA  RECORD  REQUESTED  sboms  WHEEL

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost_cpu.libs:
libgomp-e985bcbb.so.1.0.0

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost.libs:
libgomp-e985bcbb.so.1.0.0

$ uv remove xgboost
Resolved 4 packages in 6ms
      Built uv-uninstall-issue @ file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue                                                                                                                                                                              Prepared 1 package in 9ms
Uninstalled 3 packages in 5ms
Installed 1 package in 3ms
 - nvidia-nccl-cu12==2.32.3
 ~ uv-uninstall-issue==0.1.0 (from file:///development/projects/uv-uninstall-issue)
 - xgboost==3.0.5

$ uv run python -c "import xgboost; print(xgboost.__version__)"
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
    import xgboost; print(xgboost.__version__)
                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: module 'xgboost' has no attribute '__version__'

$ ls .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost*
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost:
_c_api.py  interpret.py  objective.py  testing

.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/xgboost_cpu-3.4.1.dist-info:
INSTALLER  licenses  METADATA  RECORD  REQUESTED  sboms  WHEEL

libgomp-e985bcbb.so.1.0.0
```

### Possibly related issues:
#16468
#21968 

### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-107-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.23 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

uv run python --version
title: Different packages for same module: conflict resolution and uv remove problems
